purpose: Teach: アンダー/ハリケーン/レバー/セクハラ/ワープロ/メトロ/合気道/ダイヤル

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアンダーウェアを買って帰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad brought home some new underwear.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, warm. Brief pause after his name. Conversational tone—sharing an everyday observation. Light, unselfconscious delivery, the way a parent mentions ordinary household happenings.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ハリケーンの映画見たいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to watch a hurricane movie.
lines.style: Bright and direct request. Quick pace, eager energy. Small voice, genuine excitement without being performative. The straightforward ask of a six-year-old who just thought of something he wants.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが運転のレバーを教えてくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught you how to use the car's shift lever.
lines.style: Warm recollection. Slight emphasis on 'taught'—noticing the moment that happened. Gentle, approving tone. Quiet pride that he's learning grown-up things. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Mom, what does sexual harassment mean?
lines.style: Quiet, genuinely curious. Not embarrassed—just asking for information like he would about anything else. Slight hesitation on the word itself, like he's testing it out. Straightforward, unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんがワープロでお手紙を書いてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather is writing a letter on his word processor.
lines.style: Gentle observation, warm undertone. Quiet admiration for his grandfather's efforts. Slight reverence in the pacing—acknowledging something a little old-fashioned but earnest. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが東京メトロで遅刻したんだって
lines.en: Mom, Dad was late because of the Tokyo Metro.
lines.style: Small, rueful tone—not quite a complaint, more a wry acknowledgment. Slight tilt of humor in the delivery. Quick pace. The way a six-year-old relays information he finds a little funny, with a hint of shared conspiracy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは大学で合気道してらしたのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad did aikido back when he was in university.
lines.style: Nostalgic, affectionate. Soft wonder at who her husband used to be. Unhurried pacing. Slight warmth on 'aikido'—noticing something interesting about him. A private smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんちでダイヤル電話、触ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I touched a rotary phone at Grandpa's house.
lines.style: Excited, proud of himself for discovering something new. Quick pace, bright energy. Genuine wonder in his voice—sharing something that felt special to him. Slight emphasis on 'touched,' like he's announcing an achievement.
